reasoning: The room has three clear spatial zones: a back-wall cluster of tall fixtures and wall-mounted objects, a central social cluster around the table/chair, and a left-side/open-floor zone around the bed and arcade area. There’s also a smaller right-wall zone near the dispenser and cabinet. Good lighting anchors should spread across these zones and sit just off the geometry so lights can be placed without intersecting objects.
